title: Langfuse
description: Langfuse integration for Port Ocean. One installation maps to one Langfuse project via project API keys.

configurations.name: langfusePublicKey
configurations.description: Langfuse project public key (Basic Auth username). From project settings.

configurations.name: langfuseSecretKey
configurations.description: Langfuse project secret key (Basic Auth password). From project settings.

configurations.name: langfuseHost
configurations.description: Langfuse host. EU cloud default. US: https://us.cloud.langfuse.com. JP: https://jp.cloud.langfuse.com. Or your self-hosted origin.

configurations.name: webhookSecret
configurations.description: Optional. Langfuse prompt automation webhook signing secret. When set, verifies x-langfuse-signature on /webhook.
